text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
"I heard the girls in 'Project L'Arc' are 
going on a short overseas expedition to 
France this month."

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, this is seriously the real deal. 
Maybe I should've joined in too...

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
"...You're taking this way too lightly. 
With a half-assed attitude like that, 
you'll get weeded out in no time."

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
If it's full-scale, that just proves 
everyone involved in the project is taking 
it seriously, right?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: We've arrived!!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
She's an acquaintance of Mei's, and a 
Trainer who has produced a Prix de l'Arc 
de Triomphe Umamusume in the past!

text_block_list.name: Overseas Trainer
text_block_list.text: Bonjour! Welcome, everyone from Japan!

text_block_list.name: Overseas Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Right now, it is not my team, but my 
daughter's team, however. Please, feel 
free to observe!

text_block_list.name: Trainers
text_block_list.text: Ooh...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...A short-term expedition to France. That 
was the program of "Project L'Arc."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I listen to the stories of Trainers active 
in France, taking their wisdom to heart—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...That was the plan, but I was still 
left stranded at the airport."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"It's okay, don't worry! If we catch a cab 
in a hurry, we'll make it in time!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My luggage hadn't arrived, so I inquired 
with airport staff. However, I couldn't 
figure out the procedure, which ended up 
causing trouble for Mei Satake.
choice_data_list: (If only I could speak better French...)

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ...! Hey, I can't find your wallet!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, I found my wallet and was 
finally able to regroup with everyone, but 
the first day's schedule was practically 
over.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Always scoring the lowest in the Trainer 
Training Program. And on top of that, 
causing trouble during an important 
opportunity like an expedition.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This time, and back then as well. I've 
stolen Mei Satake's time once again.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Is it really all right for someone 
like me to be part of such a meaningful 
project?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Day 3 of the short overseas campaign. —The 
day of the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
......It's finally about to begin: the 
Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe......

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Everywhere you look is so gorgeous! The 
golden grandstand, and everyone's dresses 
too!"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Depending on the seats, there's even a 
dress code. The spectators naturally carry 
themselves with class, too."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
The prestige of being number one in the 
world.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...The suit I put on for today feels 
completely out of place compared to what 
everyone around me is wearing.
choice_data_list:
...This stage is way too big for a 
newcomer.

...This stage might be a bit too big for a 
newcomer.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Um, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: You're doing your best!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Seeing how you were the other day, I... 
ended up seeing myself in you."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'm still just a rookie who recently 
debuted, after all. Compared to my 
seniors, I'm just groping my way forward 
step by step.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Mistakes are par for the course for such 
rookies. Many hardships will befall them."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
—Still, if you fear failure and hardship 
and refuse to take on challenges, you 
can't even become a rookie!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: That's right.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
And only those who take on the challenge 
and never give up can grasp their dreams.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond, Trainer <username>. Let me tell you 
a story from the past.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"...This is an old story from back when I 
first set out to take on the world with my 
friends."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Back then, the idea of winning on the 
world stage was far less common than it is 
today.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
We had no staff, our funds were limited, 
and because of that, I was running around 
day and night.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
I'll appeal to the URA board and trainers 
nationwide about just how wide the gap 
with the rest of the world is.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
I bowed my head over and over to famous 
overseas Umamusume and trainers, asking 
them to come coach in Japan.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
We supported our academy's girls in taking 
on challenges abroad. We even arranged 
races against international Umamusume for 
them.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
And with the Japan Cup setting the stage 
to compete against overseas Umamusume 
right here in Japan... it felt like the 
world had just gotten so much closer—

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
—Just when I thought I was getting closer, 
I was reminded once more of how distant 
that gap truly is.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Mei-san... Why is the gap between us and 
the world so vast?"

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
I have seen the Umamusume's tears time and 
time again.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"...I fell short. In every single way. To 
a hopeless degree."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: However—

text_block_list.name: Mei's Peer
text_block_list.text: “—Once more.”

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Every time that happened, I watched people 
pick themselves right back up.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
—Only those who never give up are allowed 
to challenge it.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: That's what makes it a dream, a romance.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"Project L'Arc" is a project that supports 
those who harbor dreams and romantic 
ideals.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"Even if you're ignorant or inexperienced 
right now, don't let it intimidate you. 
We're here to make up for that, after 
all."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Use me. Let me support you all. Having 
known failure, I know just as well how to 
lift others up.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: It's just...

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...Do you want to win? The Prix de l'Arc 
de Triomphe, that is.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Can you swear to yourself that this is a 
dream you won't give up on?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. Understood.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I'll seize it too.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Because I want to be the first Umamusume 
to open those heavily barred gates.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (KER-CLUNK!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The gates open for the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Amidst roaring cheers mingled with 
shrieks, the world's top-class Umamusume 
chase their dreams.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kicking up dirt, tearing through the wind. 
Reaching out recklessly toward the glory 
of being number one in the world.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On a stage so solemn, so fierce, where 
everyone strives to be the strongest in 
the world—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Until the day <chrname> reaches the pinnacle.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: —Those are good eyes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the ultra-short expedition to 
France came to an end.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Come the end of the year, it will be 
our first Inter-League Representative 
Match. There's no time to be hesitating."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Let's win the people's confidence that as 
part of "Project L'Arc," <chrname> can conquer the 
Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.
